headline: Colombia Bananas Face Fusarium Threat as CAN and Germany Boost Strategy
summary: The Andean Community and Germany established an 18-month agreement focusing on surveillance, biosecurity, and training to protect Colombian banana crops from the Fusarium threat.
why: Fusarium wilt is a destructive fungal disease that poses a severe threat to banana plantations and agricultural export revenues in producer nations.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Crop disease threats affect agricultural productivity and export stability.
